## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run package`
- [ ] Manual Chromium test, if behavior changed
- [ ] Manual Firefox test, if behavior changed

## Security And Privacy

- [ ] No telemetry, analytics, tracking, or remote executable code added
- [ ] No new permissions or host matches without explanation
- [ ] No secrets, private data, browser profiles, or local paths committed
